name: saved Mini before song construction
lua_assertions:
local function po(level, name, ...)
    return _ITG_OPTIONS_AT(0, 'ModsLevel_' .. level, name, ...)
end
po('Preferred', 'SetPlayerOptions', 'M730, 60% Mini')
for _, level in ipairs({'Preferred', 'Stage', 'Song', 'Current'}) do
    assert(math.abs(po(level, 'Mini') - 0.6) < 0.000001)
    assert(po(level, 'MMod') == 730)
end
local mini = po('Song', 'Mini')
local scale = (200-mini*100)/200
local speed = po('Song', 'MMod')/124
assert(math.floor(7.5*8/(speed*scale)+0.5) == 15)
